verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an API built for platform-to-platform integrations and an MCP connection to Claude. Neither item says the user can issue scoped or least-privilege credentials, choose permission scopes, or restrict what an agent can access. Issuing credentials is a fair question for an API-bearing SaaS, so the absence of evidence makes this 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
